Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Clouse
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 164 as introduced makes a supplemental appropriation of federal funds from the Alabama Emergency Rental Assistance Fund to the Department of Finance in the amount of $256,764,162 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2021. These funds will be transferred by memorandum of agreement to the Alabama Housing Finance Authority to administer the Emergency Rental Assistance Program, and any amount that remains unexpended on September 30, 2021 will be reappropriated to the Department for the same purpose for the fiscal year beginning October 1, 2021.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
